scientific_scope_status: For every d>=2, the delivered hidden-coloring construction uses four symmetric nonnegative controls, a common uniform preparation, exact live/dead observations and known norm cap1-1/(20d). Any learner giving a reusable predictor simultaneously1/16-accurate for all words through H=3d+2 with unconditional success>=2/3 on every source requires baseline expected informative preparations at least(2^d-1)/6.

unavailable_or_unclassified: The source space is enormous and the norm gap decreases with d. Symmetric nonnegative kernels may have negative spectral modes; the positive-semidefinite-only/passive subclass remains open. Reversible motions and adaptive stopping are allowed; cloning/restoring destroyed samples or fresh preparation retaining a selected hidden coloring are outside the interface. The matched disclosed-family upper route has exponential acquisition too. This is a specific observation-family obstruction, not every simulator or physical device.
